mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_capacity SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes+2147483648,reserved_slots=reserved_slots+1,next_project_id=next_project_id+1,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND reserved_slots=0 AND reserved_bytes=0 AND next_project_id=#{expectedProject}
mapper.select: SELECT id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,command_id,generation,fence,status,effect_state,owner_id,lease_until,deadline_at,version FROM pf.workspace_operation WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,command_id,generation,fence,status,effect_state,owner_id,lease_until,deadline_at,version FROM pf.workspace_operation WHERE status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND (lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_operation SET status='UNKNOWN',effect_state='MAY_HAVE_STARTED',error_code='WORKSPACE_OWNER_UNCONFIRMED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND (lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())

UPDATE pf.workspace SET state=#{state},error_code=#{error},operation_id=#{operationId},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: WITH picked AS(SELECT id FROM pf.workspace_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' OR(status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10) UPDATE pf.workspace_outbox o SET status='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM picked WHERE o.id=picked.id RETURNING o.id,o.operation_id,o.space_id,o.workspace_id,o.generation,o.fence,o.relay_owner
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED''PENDING',relay_owner=NULL,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND fence=#{item.fence} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_inbox(event_id,operation_id) VALUES(#{eventId},#{operationId}) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_outbox WHERE id=#{item.id} AND operation_id=#{item.operationId} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{item.workspaceId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND fence=#{item.fence})
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_operation SET status='CLAIMED',owner_id=#{owner},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',deadline_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '120 seconds',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_operation WHERE id=#{command.operationId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.workspaceId} AND actor_id=#{command.actorId} AND command_id=#{command.commandId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND deadline_at>clock_timestamp())
SELECT command_id,request_hash,state,result_revision FROM pf.runner_command WHERE command_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.runner_command(command_id,space_id,workspace_id,operation_id,generation,fence,request_hash,state,owner_id) VALUES(#{command.commandId},#{command.spaceId},#{command.workspaceId},#{command.operationId},#{command.generation},#{command.fence},#{hash},'RUNNING',#{command.ownerId}) ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT result_text AS result_json,content_hash FROM pf.runner_receipt WHERE command_id=#{id} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.runner_command SET state=#{receipt.state},result_revision=#{receipt.revision} WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND operation_id=#{command.operationId} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND state='RUNNING' AND result_revision=0
UPDATE pf.workspace_reservation SET status=#{state} WHERE workspace_id=#{id}
